test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Sumit's income in 2020 was Rs. 21,000. He gets an increment of 10% every year. What was his income in 2022?
solution:
**Given:**

Income in 2020 = Rs. 21,000

Increment per year = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Income in year n" id="MathJax-Element-2-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-57-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-5-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-9-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-38-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-19-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-3-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-23-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn" id="MathJax-Element-993-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">nn n n n n n n n n n n = Initial Income × (1 + Increment Rate)ⁿ

**Calculation:**

Income in 2021 = 21,000 × (1 + 0.10)

⇒ Income in 2021 = 21,000 × 1.10

⇒ Income in 2021 = 23,100

Income in 2022 = 23,100 × (1 + 0.10)

⇒ Income in 2022 = 23,100 × 1.10

⇒ Income in 2022 = 25,410

**Sumit's income in 2022 was Rs. 25,410.**
